label: A distinct esse CAUSE_2 of an actual CONCRETE_6 being at w is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to it
paraphrase: At the selected world w, for any c and x, if c is distinct from x, x is concrete and exists at w, and c causes x's esse (CausesIn c x esse, the cause-of-perfection relation at esse), then c is simply prior to x. Scoped to actual concreta at one world and to the respect esse; nothing is said of self-causes, of respects other than esse, or of non-actual effects. Derived, not assumed, by composing STMT-ESSE-CAUSE-IS-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND with STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-IS-SIMPLE-PRIORITY.
